Bake a Simple Yogurt Fruit Jelly Cake. Easy Recipe Using Basic Utensils. Few Ingredients

The video shows a step-by-step sequence, illustrating the instructions given below.

Ingredients

  • 1½ cups plain yogurt
  • ½ cup fruit jelly (your choice of flavor)
  • ½ cup warm butter
  • 2 cups wholewheat flour
  • 1 cup sugar, or sucanat (dried sugar cane syrup)
  • 2 large eggs
  • 2 TEAspoons lemon juice
  • 1 TEAspoon baking soda
  • Oil for greasing
  • Optionally, a flavoring essence or extract

Instructions

  • Preheat oven to 325°F (~160°C)
  • Grease a breadpan
  • Mix the butter with the sugar/sucanat
  • Optionally add the essence
  • Mix in the two eggs
  • Add half the flour, all the lemon juice and baking soda, and mix
  • Mix in the remaining flour
  • Mix in the yogurt
  • Spoon half the mix into the greased breadpan
  • Spoon the jelly over that, and spread evenly
  • Spoon the remaining mix over the jelly
  • Bake in the preheated oven for one hour
  • Leave to cool for an hour, then free from the breadpan
  • Slice with a bread knife
  • Enjoy!
